name: Havarti
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as it's naturally low in lactose due to the aging process. The fermentation reduces problematic sugars.
preparationTips: Let come to room temperature for best flavor and texture
Pairs excellently in melted applications like grilled cheese
Store wrapped in wax paper then plastic to maintain moisture
Can be frozen for up to 6 months, though texture may change slightly
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in calcium for bone health
